_doc: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Copy to store/costops-subscriptions.json (gitignored) and put the real plans there -- no concrete plan name, price, account or usage figure belongs in this tracked file. Consumed by src/costops/subscriptions.ts and, for the P2-C capacity view, src/costops/capacity.ts.

_fields.billing_period: P2-C. monthly | annual | weekly | unknown. STATED by the operator, never derived: two renewal dates a month apart do not prove a monthly plan, so an unset value stays 'unknown' rather than being guessed from the calendar.
_fields.paid_until: YYYY-MM-DD. The renews-then-ends date when status is canceled.
_fields.next_renewal: YYYY-MM-DD. The next charge date when status is active.
_fields.amount: OMITTED (not 0) when genuinely unknown -- set amount_source to say why.
_fields.weekly_limit_tokens: OPTIONAL absolute ceiling, only if a real one is known. No provider here publishes one; absent means limits.ts reports 'unknown' instead of inventing a denominator.
_fields.usage_snapshot: OPTIONAL. A MANUAL reading off a provider usage screen -- percent plus the VERBATIM reset label, never a derived token count and never a parsed calendar date. P2-C promotes this into provider_ratelimit_snapshots with confidence 'manual'; the storage layer REFUSES to let it claim 'measured', because no Anthropic quota/usage API exists (re-verified 2026-07-30).
